name: code_editor_epoch
sql:
CREATE TABLE code_editor_epoch (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 record_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(record_version=1),
 epoch TEXT NOT NULL
)

name: code_owner_file_active
sql:
CREATE INDEX code_owner_file_active ON code_owner_file_leases(epoch,expires_at)
 WHERE state='active'

name: code_owner_file_leases
sql:
CREATE TABLE code_owner_file_leases (
 record_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(record_version=1),
 checkout TEXT NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL,
 path TEXT NOT NULL, holder TEXT NOT NULL, epoch TEXT NOT NULL,
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(token_hash)=64),
 acquired_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(acquired_generation>0),
 released_generation INTEGER CHECK(released_generation=acquired_generation+1),
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','released')),
 CHECK((state='active')=(released_generation IS NULL)),
 PRIMARY KEY(checkout,path)
)

name: code_writer_active
sql:
CREATE INDEX code_writer_active ON code_writer_reservations(checkout)
 WHERE state IN ('reserved','ambiguous')

name: code_writer_reservations
sql:
CREATE TABLE code_writer_reservations (
 record_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(record_version=1),
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, checkout TEXT NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL,
 paths TEXT CHECK(paths IS NULL OR json_valid(paths)),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','ambiguous','released'))
)

name: native_worktree_active_draft
sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX native_worktree_active_draft ON native_worktree_starts(project_id,draft_id)
 WHERE state IN ('pending','uncertain','bound')

name: native_worktree_bound_immutable
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER native_worktree_bound_immutable
 BEFORE UPDATE OF project_id,actor_id,request_id,draft_id,draft_version,digest,
  intent_version,state,plan_json,witness_json,runtime_task_id,error_code ON native_worktree_starts
 WHEN OLD.state='bound' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable'); END

name: native_worktree_bound_keep
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER native_worktree_bound_keep
 BEFORE DELETE ON native_worktree_starts
 WHEN OLD.state='bound' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable'); END

name: native_worktree_starts
sql:
CREATE TABLE native_worktree_starts (
 project_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 draft_id TEXT NOT NULL, draft_version INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 intent_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(intent_version=1),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','bound','failed-known','uncertain')),
 plan_json TEXT, witness_json TEXT, runtime_task_id TEXT UNIQUE, error_code TEXT,
 close_cleanup TEXT, purge_cleanup TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(project_id,actor_id,request_id)
)

name: host_transcript_by_message
sql: CREATE INDEX host_transcript_by_message ON host_transcript(session_id, kind, message_id)
